about: Guirca articles whose main photo (<nr>.jpg) shows the product twice: the same photo again, or a collage with the article's other photos. The import and the storefront leave that photo out when the product has other photos. codes is written by: python3 scripts/guirca/import_guirca.py doubles <sheet> --image-status images.tsv; by_eye are the ones found by looking at the photos the command missed, and are kept when it runs again.
